backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a logo fallback enhancement tied to SiteHeader.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files and their roles in the app.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Production deployment guide covering checks, common build blockers, and required configs.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color tokens for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React layout composing header, sections, and footer.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Client‑validated contact form with field errors, simulated submit, and status messages.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section rendering mission text and three core values with icons.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Renders the contact section with email, address, phone details and a contact form, including phone sanitization for tel links.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Displays the hero banner with background image, headline text, CTA buttons, and smooth scrolling to sections.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows a grid of service cards using marketing copy and mapped icons for each service.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with brand text, quick links, social icons, and smooth-scroll behavior.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header with scroll effects, mobile menu, and resilient multi‑stage logo fallback.
frontend/src/content/brandAssets.ts: Provides centralized paths for large and standard logo assets.
frontend/src/content/marketingCopy.ts: Contains static text content for hero, about, services, and contact sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook for login, logout, and identity state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query hooks using the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and light/dark theme color variables for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/tsconfig.node.json: Defines TypeScript options for Vite’s Node environment, including ESNext modules and bundler resolution.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Sets up Vite with React, an alias for src, build output settings, and a dev server on port 3000.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current state, existing logo-loading issue, required assets, and pending feature requests.
